name: E-Commerce Defective Smartphone Refund Denial
raw_input: I ordered a Samsung Galaxy smartphone worth Rs 26,999 on an e-commerce app on 10th November 2024. It was delivered on 14th November. Within 24 hours of opening the box, the screen started flickering with green lines and touch stopped working. I raised a replacement request on 15th November. The app sent a technician for inspection on 21st November. The technician confirmed it is a manufacturing hardware defect and took sign on his job sheet. But on 23rd November, customer support cancelled my return request stating 'The 7-day return window expired on 21st November'. They are telling me to go to an authorized brand service center 40 km away. I paid for a brand new working phone, not a defective phone repaired on day one. I have the invoice, delivery receipt, technician inspection job sheet copy, and chat screenshots.

case_dossier.case_title: Defective Samsung Galaxy Phone Delivered by E-commerce Platform
case_dossier.summary: The consumer purchased a Samsung Galaxy smartphone for Rs 26,999 on an e‑commerce app. The phone malfunctioned within a day, a technician confirmed a hardware defect, but the platform denied a return citing an expired 7‑day window and directed the consumer to a distant service centre.

timeline.event: Placed order for Samsung Galaxy smartphone worth Rs 26,999 on the e‑commerce app.
Raised a replacement/return request after the screen flickered and touch stopped within 24 hours of opening.
Technician visited, inspected the phone, confirmed manufacturing hardware defect, and signed a job sheet.
Customer support cancelled the return request, stating the 7‑day return window expired on 21 Nov and advised going to an authorized service centre 40 km away.

evidence_held: Invoice showing purchase price of Rs 26,999
Delivery receipt confirming receipt on 14 Nov 2024
Copy of technician inspection job sheet with signature
Chat screenshots with customer support regarding the return request and cancellation
evidence_needed: Original signed technician job sheet (if copy is not sufficient)
Timestamped confirmation/email of the replacement/return request submitted on 15 Nov 2024
Record of the 7‑day return policy terms as displayed on the app at the time of purchase
Any email or SMS notification of the cancellation decision dated 23 Nov 2024
Proof of the authorized service centre’s distance and any additional costs that may be incurred
case_dossier.evidence_strength_explanation: Key documents (invoice, delivery receipt, signed job sheet, chat logs) directly support the claim, giving the evidence a strong but not perfect rating.

escalation_check.legal_aid_contact: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) / NALSA Toll-Free Helpline: 15100

rights_advice.plain_language_standing: You are a consumer as defined by the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 because you bought a Samsung Galaxy phone online for personal use. The phone turned out to be defective within a day, and a qualified technician confirmed a manufacturing fault. Under the Act, a defect in goods and a deficiency in the service (the e‑commerce platform’s refusal to honour a return despite the defect) give you a clear right to a replacement, repair, or refund. The platform’s claim that the 7‑day window has expired, even though the defect was reported within that period and the law requires a refund or replacement within 30 days of delivery for defective goods, is an unfair trade practice. This is a civil dispute, not a criminal offence, so you can seek redress through the consumer forum without needing to file a police FIR.

governing_laws.relevance: Defines you as a consumer because you purchased the phone online for personal use.
Covers the hardware defect in the phone as a "defect in goods".
Treats the platform’s refusal to replace/repair the defective phone as a "deficiency in service".
Identifies the platform’s denial of refund/replacement after a defect as an unfair trade practice.
Allows you to file a consumer complaint electronically via e‑Daakhil.
Makes the product manufacturer liable for manufacturing defects, supporting your claim for a refund or replacement.
Clarifies that this is a civil matter, not a criminal cheating case.

action_options.title: Send a Formal Legal Demand Notice
action_options.cost_estimate: Free to minimal (postage or email cost)
action_options.details: Draft a concise notice stating: (a) you are a consumer under CPA 2019, (b) the phone has a manufacturing defect confirmed by a technician, (c) the e‑commerce platform is violating Section 2(47) by refusing a refund/replacement, and (d) you demand a full refund of Rs 26,999 or a replacement within 7 days of receipt of the notice. Send it by registered post or email and keep a copy of the receipt.

action_options.title: File an Electronic Complaint on e‑Daakhil
action_options.cost_estimate: Zero court fee for claims up to Rs 5 Lakhs
action_options.details: Register on edaakhil.nic.in. Upload the following documents: purchase invoice, delivery receipt, technician’s signed job sheet, chat screenshots, and a copy of the demand notice. Choose the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC) as the forum. Pay the nominal filing fee (if any) online and note the complaint number for future reference.

action_options.title: Attend the Consumer Forum Hearing / Seek Enforcement
action_options.details: The forum will issue a notice to the e‑commerce platform. You can appear yourself (self‑representation is allowed) and present the evidence you have. If the forum orders a refund or replacement and the platform still does not comply, you can file for execution of the order through the district court.

rights_advice.real_lawyer_guidance: The Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions allow you to represent yourself, so a lawyer is not mandatory. You may consult a lawyer for advice on drafting the demand notice or if the platform files a counter‑claim, but you can comfortably handle the filing and hearing on your own.
rights_advice.disclaimer: ⚠️ NyayaMitra provides legal information and self‑advocacy tools under Indian laws. For formal courtroom representation, consult a licensed advocate.

legal_notice_draft:
## **LEGAL DEMAND NOTICE** *(Consumer & E‑Commerce – Defective Samsung Galaxy Phone)* --- ### **1. Header** | **From (Sender)** | **To (Recipient)** | |-------------------|--------------------| | **Name:** *[Your Full Name]*
**Address:** *[Your Complete Residential Address]*
**Mobile:** *[Your Mobile No.]*
**E‑mail:** *[Your Email ID]* | **Name:** *[E‑Commerce Platform – Legal/Customer Service Department]*
**Address:** *[Registered Office / Corporate Address as per website]*
**E‑mail:** *[Official Support Email]* | --- ### **2. Date & Mode of Dispatch** - **Date:** *[Insert Date – e.g., 7 November 2026]* - **Mode of Dispatch:** **Speed Post – Acknowledgement Due (AD)** / **Registered E‑mail (with read‑receipt)** *(Both copies are being sent – one by Speed Post and one by registered e‑mail for redundancy and proof of service.)* --- ### **3. Subject** > **Demand for Refund / Replacement of Defective Samsung Galaxy Smartphone (Order No. [XXXX]) purchased for Rs 26,999** --- ### **4. Opening Paragraph (Instruction Clause)** > **Under instructions from my client, the undersigned hereby submits as under:** --- ### **5. Statement of Facts (Chronological Sequence)** | **Date / Period** | **Event** | |-------------------|-----------| | **10 Nov 2024** | Placed an order for a *Samsung Galaxy* smartphone (Model: *[Exact Model]*, Price: **Rs 26,999**) on the e‑commerce app of *[Platform Name]* (Order No. [XXXX]). | | **14 Nov 2024** | Phone was delivered to the above‑stated residential address; delivery receipt attached (Annexure‑B). | | **15 Nov 2024** | Within 24 hours of unboxing, the screen began flickering and the touch panel stopped responding. A replacement/return request was lodged through the app’s “Return/Replace” facility (timestamped copy attached – Annexure‑D). | | **21 Nov 2024** | A certified technician from *[Authorized Service Provider]* visited, inspected the device, diagnosed a **manufacturing hardware defect**, and signed the job‑sheet confirming the same (Annexure‑C). | | **23 Nov 2024** | Customer‑support executive cancelled the return request, stating that the 7‑day return window had expired on 21 Nov 2024 and directed the consumer to an authorized service centre located **≈ 40 km** away (chat screenshots attached – Annexure‑D). | --- ### **6. Documents Annexed (Evidence)** | **Annexure** | **Description** | |--------------|-----------------| | **Annexure‑A** | Original invoice showing purchase price **Rs 26,999**. | | **Annexure‑B** | Delivery receipt confirming receipt on **14 Nov 2024**. | | **Annexure‑C** | Technician’s inspection job‑sheet (signed) confirming a manufacturing defect. | | **Annexure‑D** | Chat‑screen captures with customer‑support showing the return request, its cancellation, and the 7‑day window claim. | | **Annexure‑E** *(optional)* | Screenshot of the platform’s “7‑day return policy” as displayed at the time of purchase. | --- ### **7. Legal Grounds** 1. **Consumer Protection Act, 2019** - **Section 2(7)** – Defines the complainant as a *consumer* (purchase for personal use). - **Section 2(10)** – The hardware defect constitutes a *defect in goods*. - **Section 2(11)** – The platform’s refusal to replace/repair amounts to a *deficiency in service*. - **Section 2(47)** – Denial of refund/replacement after a confirmed defect is an *unfair trade practice*. *Reference:* *Consumer Protection (Consumer Protection) Rules, 2020* – Rule 3 (right to replacement/repair within 30 days of delivery for defective goods). 2. **Statutory Interest & Compensation** - Under **[unverified reference removed]** of the CPA, the consumer is entitled to **interest at the rate of 12 % per annum** on the amount due, calculated from the date of default (i.e., from **23 Nov 2024**). - The consumer may also claim **damages for loss of enjoyment and inconvenience** as per **[unverified reference removed](2)**. --- ### **8. Demand (15‑Day Rectification Window)** > **You are hereby directed to effect either:** 1. **A full refund of Rs 26,999 (Rupees Twenty‑Six Thousand Nine Hundred Ninety‑Nine only)**, **or** 2. **A brand‑new replacement of the same model (Samsung Galaxy – identical specifications)** > **within **_**fifteen (15) calendar days**_** from the receipt of this notice (i.e., on or before **[Date + 15 days]**).** > The refund/replacement must be credited to the bank account **[Your Bank Details]** or the replacement dispatched to the address mentioned above, at **no additional cost** to the consumer. --- ### **9. Consequence of Non‑Compliance** - **Failure to comply** within the stipulated 15‑day period will compel the consumer to **file a complaint before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC)** under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, seeking: 1. **Refund of Rs 26,999** with **statutory interest at 12 % per annum** from 23 Nov 2024 till actual payment. 2. **Compensation for inconvenience and mental agony** (as deemed fit by the Commission). 3. **Recovery of litigation costs, postage, and any other expenses** incurred. - The consumer also reserves the right to **approach the appropriate consumer forum for execution of the award** and to **report the unfair trade practice** to the **Competition Commission of India** and **State Consumer Protection Council**. --- ### **10. Legal Disclaimer** > This notice is issued **without prejudice** to any other rights or remedies available to the consumer under the law. The consumer expressly reserves all such rights. --- ### **11. Signature & Verification** | **Signature of the Consumer** | **Date** | |-------------------------------|----------| | _____________________________ | __________ | *The consumer affirms that the facts stated herein are true and correct to the best of his/her knowledge and belief.* --- ### **12. sample_roleplay_turn.user_argument: Under Section 2(11) and Section 84 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019, delivering a defective phone and delaying inspection past your return window is a clear deficiency in service and unfair trade practice. I have the technician report confirming hardware fault. I demand an immediate refund or I will escalate to the National Consumer Helpline and e-Daakhil.

opponent_response.opponent_reply: Look, I have already explained our stance. We operate strictly by our terms and policies, so I cannot agree to this right now.

coach_evaluation.what_went_well: You maintained a clear and determined position.
coach_evaluation.what_to_improve: Quote the exact 15-day timeline and statutory liability under Indian law.
